questions.q: In a pyodbc connection string, what does Trusted_Connection=yes mean?
options: The query results are cached permanently
The connection will never time out
Use Windows authentication instead of a SQL username and password
Skip encrypting the connection
questions.explain: Trusted_Connection=yes authenticates using the current Windows login instead of UID/PWD.

options: Only the first matching row
Every matching row from the last executed query
The total row count of the table
The query's SQL text as a string
questions.explain: fetchall() pulls back every row the query matched, while fetchone() returns just one.

questions.q: Why connect directly to a database instead of always exporting to CSV first?
options: CSV exports are always more secure
Direct connections always run faster regardless of query
A direct connection sees current data and lets the database handle filtering and sorting
Databases cannot export to CSV at all
questions.explain: A CSV export is a snapshot that can go stale the moment the source table changes.
